title: Uniqueness of the system pullback presentation
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l, with its quotient coefficient sequence. For every scheme map f : X → Y, the published sequence-site direct image pullbackTensorSequenceDirect equals AmbientPullbackTensor.push f none, their chosen left adjoints are equal, and their exact-derived inverse images are equal. For any two Operations presentations o,o′ and section-normalized Compositors c,c′, and any composable f,g, the ordinary direct-image compositors c.ordinaryDirect(f,g), c′.ordinaryDirect(f,g) are equal; so are their ordinary inverse-image compositors and derived pullback compositors. These are equalities of actual sequence-site functors and transformations before evaluation. [def-sf-integral-system-operations] [lem-sf-ambient-pullback-tensor-coherence] [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]
